notes.title: New free game! Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1036950/ss_4637cfdf98aaac02d1f34cb1449cec2047ece0e6.1920x1080.jpg?t=1554376368[/img]

Greetings! We are happy to announce the release of our new FREE game! Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Generations!

30 free puzzles and more added each month! 4 difficulties, rotation, zoom, puzzles up to 800 pieces!

Also if you like it we have many puzzle packs, now at 20% discount!

And you can buy all the packs in a bundle up to an additional 50% discount! Isn't that amazing?

[h1]Just relax and make puzzles![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036950/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Generations/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1036950/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Generations/[/url]

notes.title: More translations and new features!
notes.content:
Hi guys! We are happy to announce that we added two more translations to Super Jigsaw Puzzle, japanese and portuguese! 

Also now there is a couple of new features available:

- You can change between boxes with the 1-7 keys on the keyboard
- You can send pieces to the selected box with the mouse middle button

We hope you like this. Thanks for playing and keep having fun!

[h1]Just relax and make puzzles![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/792650/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/792650/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle/[/url]

notes.title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space now available!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/951700/ss_d710d1862360f0c8fcb238e887bf0bd8e3631809.1920x1080.jpg?t=1540559767[/img]

Hi guys! We just released our fourth game of the Super Jigsaw Puzzle series, Super Jigsaw Puzzle: Space! 

You can now make puzzles while traveling the universe! Mars, Pluto, The Milky Way, the Sombrero Galaxy and much much more! 30 puzzles are waiting for you in 5 difficulties, an amazing soundtrack and everything you need to relax and take a break from our busy lives.

And we added a few new features! Now you have to rotate the pieces to put them right, you can change the boxes with the keyboard numbers and send pieces directly to them with the middle mouse button! [b]And the best of all, now we have a new difficulty, puzzles with 800 pieces![/b] It's insane!

Remember that you can buy the four games in a bundle with a 25% discount, even if you have the other three games already!

[h1]Just relax and make puzzles![/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/951700/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Space/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/951700/Super_Jigsaw_Puzzle_Space/[/url]

notes.title: Small update! Steam Summer Sales are almost over!
notes.content:
Hello guys!

We uploaded yesterday a small update to add some extra background music to Super Jigsaw Puzzle and an option to choose if you want the pieces to vibrate or not when they are in the board.

Also we want to thank you all for all the sales during the Steam Summer Sales. You guys are the best! And if you don't have the other puzzles in the series, you can buy them in the next 9 hours at a cheaper price! Hurry!

[h1]And keep it having fun making puzzles![/h1]

The Flat Cat Team

notes.title: Super Jigsaw Puzzle worldwide!
notes.content:
Hi guys! We are gladly to announce that we just finished the localization of Super Jigsaw Puzzle to French, German, Italian, Russian, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese, an amazing work by the people from Level Up Translation.

This languages plus our initial translation in English and Spanish makes Super Jigsaw Puzzle now translated in eight languages! Yay!

So feel free to tell to all your international friends that now they can make amazing jigsaw puzzles in their language!

Thank you all!
